author: Fextralife
description:
Guns of Eschaton GAMEPLAY Impressions - I Played It...
In this video, I'm going to be talking about my hands-on impressions playing Guns of Eschaton. I've played about 2 or 3 hours of this game so far. There was a demo that was available, that I think is going to be publicly available pretty soon, but this game is a self-professed first-person soulslike. And when you think of it, the first thing that comes to mind immediately in terms of comparison is Valor Mortis.
